summary: Iter 227 Direct Payment (service vendors) – FRONTEND e2e via Playwright on preview URL. All 11 requested flows PASS: SR page 'Direct Payment' button -> /app/services/direct-payments with form open; sidebar nav-svc-direct-payments; create flow (vendor search filter, vendor summary GSTIN/last paid/counts, Ref PO pre-selected + project auto-filled, net ₹29,000, payment auto 29000, manual 20000 sticks even when TDS changes, exceeds-warning shown, toast, row PENDING APPROVAL + amber triangle); detail dialog (payment ₹20,000, warnings box, history 'raised', vendor payment history); edit (vendor disabled, 19000 saved, history 'edited'); approve -> toast 'sent to Payment Processing', status PAYMENT PENDING, queue tile 0->1, row SDP-2026-0010 'Direct Payment (Service Vendor)' ₹19,000 listed in /app/accounts/payment-processing Pending Verification; reject with empty remarks -> 'Remarks are required to reject' then REJECTED; withdraw -> WITHDRAWN; My Pending Approvals lists 'Direct Payments' source with amount + inbox-approve/inbox-reject, approve works -> PAYMENT PENDING with approval stamp; status/vendor/search filters narrow table; sales: no New button, no approve/reject, no crash; purchase: New button shown, own pending detail has only Edit/Withdraw. Regression: SR list + svc-req-form-dialog, /app/services/invoices render OK. No page errors. Only minor UI issues found.

minor.issue: Status check and update are not atomic (update_one filter is only {id}); two concurrent approve calls could both pass the pending_approval check and push the DP to the payment queue twice. Add status:'pending_approval' to the update filter and check modified_count.

ui_bugs.issue: Withdraw button is shown to ANY user for a pending request (only checks status). Verified: sales@erp.com sees Withdraw on purchase's SDP-2026-0014; clicking -> 403 toast 'Only the requester can withdraw this request'. Same for Edit: shown whenever meta.can_raise even if the user is not the requester (backend PUT rejects non-requester non-super-admin). Gate both on viewing.created_by_id === currentUser.id || role === super_admin.

'Awaiting approval' / 'In payment queue' tiles are computed from the filtered rows, so applying status/vendor/search filters changes them (e.g. search 'zzzz' -> Awaiting approval 0 while a pending DP exists). Either label as '(listed)' or compute from unfiltered data/meta.
When filters return no rows the table says 'No Direct Payment requests yet.' – misleading; should say 'No requests match the filters'.

issues: Two vendors both named 'RAHUL' with no code appear identically in the vendor dropdown and filter – add GSTIN/code to disambiguate.
After 'Save changes' on an edit, the attachments dialog auto-opens again (onSaved always setDocsFor) – only needed after create.

action_items: Hide Edit/Withdraw in DP detail unless current user is the requester (created_by_id) or super_admin
Make approve/reject/withdraw update atomic with status filter to avoid double queue push
Tiles: compute from unfiltered data or relabel; fix empty-state text when filters active
(optional) disambiguate duplicate vendor names in selects; don't reopen attachments dialog after edit
